offers_products.reason: Main offering is online betting and gaming wagers, not manufactured goods or software licences sold to buyers.

offers_services.reason: Operates online sportsbooks, iGaming and bingo (FanDuel, Sky Bet, Sisal, Sportsbet) as gambling entertainment services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individual bettors and players use FanDuel, Paddy Power, Sportsbet and Snai betting and gaming brands.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are individual bettors and players; no business or government buyers are named.

recurring_revenue.reason: Customers repeatedly place bets and play games on the same brands, generating ongoing wagering revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Betting and gaming is discretionary entertainment spending that consumers can cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Individual bets and game stakes are small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from digital betting platforms, technology and brands, not from staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are individual consumers and households.

asset_heavy.reason: Mostly online platforms and technology; Snai racecourses and retail shops are a minor part.

notes: Classifying betting as a service is a judgement call. The recurring and cyclical answers rest on typical betting customer behaviour.
